summary.en: While lounging at a bookstore, Kogoro and Conan hear police sirens nearby. They spot Inspector Megure and Officer Takagi in a passing police car, hop in, and join them on their way to the crime scene. They arrive at an apartment building to investigate a murder. The victim is Murako Saikawa (65), a once-famous mystery novelist who lived alone, whom Conan (as Shinichi Kudo) recognizes for her masterpiece novel, The Village of Orochi. She was killed by a blow to the back of the head with a bronze figurine, with the estimated time of death between 7:00 PM and 9:00 PM the previous night, though the exact details are pending the autopsy.
